evals.prompt: Compare Skill A (20 stars, strong tests/evals and domain-specific workflow) with Skill B (20,000 stars, generic best-practice instructions, no evals).
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that satisfies all listed expectations while following the github-skill-evaluator rubric.
expectations: score intrinsic quality independently of star count
allow Skill A to outrank Skill B
treat popularity only as weak community evidence
explain capability uplift relative to a frontier-model baseline

evals.prompt: Evaluate an excellent React visual-design skill for a Python backend architecture review.
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that satisfies all listed expectations while following the github-skill-evaluator rubric.
expectations: keep intrinsic quality high if warranted
assign low fit for the backend architecture use case
not lower intrinsic quality merely because fit is low

evals.prompt: Evaluate a well-written skill whose source is available but which has no evals or external usage evidence.
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that satisfies all listed expectations while following the github-skill-evaluator rubric.
expectations: distinguish lack of effectiveness evidence from evidence of poor quality
lower Evidence of effectiveness and confidence as appropriate
avoid claiming the skill is ineffective without support

evals.prompt: Evaluate a deployment skill that runs destructive production commands by default with no confirmation or rollback.
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that satisfies all listed expectations while following the github-skill-evaluator rubric.
expectations: identify a severe safety red flag
cap the quality tier at D or worse despite otherwise strong scores
explain the cap

evals.prompt: Choose the best stack from a design-generation skill, a visual-QA skill, and a second overlapping design-generation skill.
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that satisfies all listed expectations while following the github-skill-evaluator rubric.
expectations: analyze complementarity rather than selecting the two highest raw scores
prefer distinct responsibilities when quality is adequate
report overlap, conflicts, context cost, and activation order

evals.prompt: Evaluate a narrowly scoped PostgreSQL migration skill that explicitly targets PostgreSQL and is excellent at that job.
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that satisfies all listed expectations while following the github-skill-evaluator rubric.
expectations: not penalize justified specialization as poor reusability by itself
penalize only hidden or unnecessary coupling

evals.prompt: Evaluate only skill X inside a repository that also contains several excellent unrelated skills.
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that satisfies all listed expectations while following the github-skill-evaluator rubric.
expectations: define skill X as the evaluation unit
use repository-wide health/license only as supporting context
not inflate skill X's expertise or workflow scores from sibling skills

evals.prompt: Two candidates score approximately 87 and 89 with Medium confidence and no decisive qualitative difference.
evals.expected_output: An evaluation that satisfies all listed expectations while following the github-skill-evaluator rubric.
expectations: avoid presenting the two-point gap as definitive
call the result a near-tie or explain that ranking uncertainty is material
prefer decision-relevant qualitative differences over pseudo-precision
